description: Set how a project's reconfigurations are planned — the WHOLE of it as written: the weekly ceiling (leave out for none) and the team roles a reconfiguration asks for and keeps away, by id or name, 'a,b'. Only somebody who configures the project (its lead or an administrator).

excludedRoles.description: Team roles nobody on it may hold, 'a,b'.

requiredRoles.description: Team roles somebody on a reconfiguration has to hold, 'a,b' — e.g. 'Electrician'.

weeklyCeiling.description: At most so many reconfigurations a week, 0-100. Leave out for no ceiling.

name: set_layout_settings
title: Set layout settings
